name: Flashlight
effect: Counts as a light source for Charlie checks.
tooltip: Persistent. Cancels Charlie attacks at night.

name: Crowbar
effect: +1 Attack die in combat. Pry: free action to open sealed Threats/containers.

name: First Aid Kit
effect: Single-use. Restore 4 Health to any player at your location.
tooltip: Heals one ally up to 4 Health.

name: Bandage
effect: Single-use. Restore 2 Health.

name: Improvised Bat
effect: +1 Attack die. Breaks on natural 1.

name: Sharpened Spoon
effect: +1 Attack die. No fumble penalty.
tooltip: Crude but reliable. Good against Down threats.

name: Slingshot
effect: Range. Attack a Threat at an adjacent location.

name: Toy Bow
effect: Range. +1 Attack die at range.

name: Stuffed Animal
effect: Sleep with this: +2 Sanity at Tick.

name: Photo Album
effect: Storytelling: +1 Sanity to all at your location.

name: Music Player
effect: Storytelling: +2 Sanity to all at your location once per Night.

name: Warm Blanket
effect: Sleep: +1 Sanity. Negates 1 Charlie damage.
tooltip: A small barrier against the dark.

name: Energy Bar
effect: Single-use. Restore 3 Hunger.

name: Hot Cocoa
effect: Single-use. Restore 2 Hunger and 1 Sanity.

name: Backpack
effect: Persistent. Gather drawn at +1 (gather 2 instead of 1).

name: Circle of Salt
effect: Single-use. Place at your location: bosses cannot enter for 1 Night.

name: Clue: A Cassette
effect: Truth card 1 of 3. Listen at your location: read the next Phase deck top card.

name: Clue: A Burned Note
effect: Truth card 2 of 3. At Night: reveals a Threat deck top card.

name: Clue: A Polaroid
effect: Truth card 3 of 3. Photograph reveals a Source weakness on Day 7 (-2 Source HP at Day 7 reveal).

name: Radio
effect: Storytelling: gather players around. Adjacent allies +1 Sanity at Night.
tooltip: A familiar voice in the static.

name: Headphones
effect: Persistent. Negates 1 Sanity loss per Day.

name: Camera
effect: Single-use. Look at top 3 Threat cards then put back in any order.

name: Lantern
effect: Counts as Fire. Persistent.
tooltip: Fire is more reliable than electric.

name: Fire Starter Kit
effect: Free action: light a Fire at your location for 1 Night (counts as Fire).

name: Toolbox
effect: Persistent. Crafting actions cost 1 fewer resource (minimum 1).

name: Duct Tape
effect: Repair a broken Item or stabilize a Down character (1 Health).

name: Sports Drink
effect: Single-use. Restore 2 Hunger and 1 Sanity.

name: Protein Bar
effect: Single-use. Restore 4 Hunger.

name: Portable Crockpot
effect: Persistent. Allows cooking at any tile (not just kitchen).

name: Whistle
effect: Single-use. Move all players at adjacent tiles to your location.

name: House Keys
effect: Persistent. Lock your house against entering Threats for 1 Night.

name: Pepper Spray
effect: Single-use. Force a Threat to retreat to an adjacent tile.

name: Old Cellphone
effect: Single-use. Look at the top of any deck.

name: Dog Leash
effect: Persistent. Once per Day: pull an adjacent ally to your tile.
tooltip: There used to be a dog.

name: Hairspray + Lighter
effect: Single-use. +2 Attack dice this combat. Counts as Fire.

name: Chainsaw
effect: +2 Attack dice. Loud (draws +1 Threat next Night).

name: Reinforced Door
effect: Persistent. Place at a house tile. That tile gets +2 defense.

name: Barricade
effect: Persistent. Place at a sport court. +1 defense at that tile.

name: Campfire
effect: Persistent. Place at any tile. Counts as Fire for all there.

name: Watchtower
effect: Persistent. From this tile see top of Threat deck.

name: Rabbit's Foot
effect: Persistent. Once per game: reroll any 1 die.

name: Thermos
effect: Persistent. Carry 1 cooked Recipe for later use.

name: Case of Energy Drinks
effect: Persistent. Provides 1 Energy Drink per Dawn (use or lose).

name: School Bell
effect: Single-use. Move the Doom marker -1.

name: Lockpick Set
effect: Persistent. Pry: free action to open sealed/locked things.
tooltip: Same as Crowbar pry without the +1 attack.

name: Friendship Bracelet
effect: Single-use. Give to any ally: they gain +2 Sanity.

name: Notebook & Pen
effect: Persistent. Track ongoing effects (also a flavorful prop). Once per game peek any deck.

name: Pry Bar
effect: Persistent. Pry only (no combat bonus).

name: Bicycle
effect: Persistent. Move actions cost 0 Hunger.
